hints.title: Leaf-to-Root Path Construction
hints.text: Construct paths from root to leaves and reverse each path to obtain strings starting at leaves and ending at the root.

hints.title: Tracking Lexicographical Minimum
hints.text: Maintain the globally smallest string seen across all leaf paths. Only complete paths ending at a leaf node should be compared.

hints.title: DFS with Character Conversion
hints.text: Append chr(ord("a") + node.val) to path. If node is a leaf (no left and no right), reverse path, compare with smallest string, and update. Backtrack by popping character upon return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy top-down choices do not guarantee the smallest leaf string because leaf depth and later characters determine lexicographical order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visiting every root-to-leaf path takes O(N) node visits, spending O(H) string comparison time per leaf.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note that a node is a leaf only when both left and right children are null.
